messages:
support: FYI Acme called—saw ~30% of requests returning 5xx/gateway timeouts across hosted region us-west-2 during a tenant spike. Customer impact: checkout API.

sam (eng-sre): Copy. Got traces?

support: Pasted logs from gateway and a sample request id. They saw long queue wait + 502 from gateway: 

support: ```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] tenant=acme req=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=504 backend_wait_ms=4500 backend_resp_ms=120
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] pod=redwood-infer-abc ready=false reason=model-init timeout_ms=60000
```

olivia (oncall): Looks like scale-up lag + pod not ready long enough. Any KEDA events?

raj (infra): KEDA metrics show a spike in queue length and then a flurry of scaledObjects created but readiness durations are long (~45-60s). Also saw auth failures around same time: token fetch 403s for some tenants.

sam (eng-sre): Auth 403s + token rotation during traffic spike could cause model fetch failures and block readiness. If the model init blocks readiness probe, HPA/KEDA won't route traffic and gateway will queue until timeout.

maria (customer-success): Customer mentions a billing authorization rotation happened 14:00 (their side). They started heavy traffic at 14:01.

olivia (oncall): Repro steps request from SRE: 1) Simulate tenant burst with 200 parallel requests 2) Trigger token rotate (simulated 403 on model artifact request) 3) Observe pod init/readiness and gateway 504s.

sam (eng-sre): Quick mitigation for hosted: bump minReplicas for the tenant's pool to 2, enable prewarm for that tenant, and add a fallback model variant that is smaller (quantized) for initial fallbacks.

raj (infra): I'll patch the scaledObject annotation to increase cooldown and set stableReplicaCount=2 for the affected pool. Also patch readiness probe to not fail fast on transient model-fetch 403s: tolerate retries for 30s.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-8260004321 - autoscale/tenant-burst-auth-rotate. Assigned: sam (eng-sre).

sam (eng-sre): Notes — probable root: overlapping token rotation + tenant burst -> KEDA creates pods which then fail readiness due to failed artifact auth and long model init. Gateway queues requests -> 5xx/timeouts.

maria (customer-success): Customer wants ETA. We told them mitigation applied (increase minReplicas, prewarm). Asking for postmortem and action items.

sam (eng-sre): Action items: 1) Add early-degraded fallback model that can serve until full model is ready (quantized smaller) 2) Improve prewarm policy to start warm pool on token rotations for affected tenants 3) Harden readiness probe to accept transient auth errors and retry model fetches 4) Add alert for token-rotate+queue-spike correlation.

olivia (oncall): I'm capturing all commands/patches used. Repro ticket created in infra board with steps and kube snippets.

raj (infra): Patching scaledobject now, will monitor.

support: Customer confirmed reduced 5xx after minReplicas bump. They still want root cause analysis.

sam (eng-sre): Will run the reproducible test in staging with token rotate + burst and record timings. Will follow-up with timeline and a short postmortem.

maria (customer-success): Thanks, will update the customer. :thumbsup:

olivia (oncall): Closing temporary oncall tick for now; leave incident open until postmortem.

sam (eng-sre): Pushed a draft postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-8260004321 (internal). Will add logs and k8s events.

support: Adding logs to incident.

raj (infra): Monitoring shows readiness latency dropped to ~8s after patch. Queue length normalized.

maria (customer-success): Customer follow-up scheduled for 2026-03-16 09:00 PT.

sam (eng-sre): Closing notes: likely combo of auth rotation + insufficient prewarm/minReplicas. Recommend org-wide guardrails for token rotations during high traffic windows.
